verdict.rationale: Riveter's API lets you pull run results programmatically: the /runs/{id}/result endpoint, paginated run listing in the Go SDK, and webhooks that POST full results as JSON. That gives a way to retrieve generated data, but nothing in the evidence describes a dedicated export or account-wide takeout. missing for 10: explicit data-export feature, documented open export formats (CSV/JSON download), full-account export including projects/configurations, any offboarding or data-portability documentation, independent corroboration.
